investigation_notes.Playbook Used: Azure Network Security Group Modification Triage
investigation_notes.Request Body Summary: Added inbound Allow rule 'Test' allowing TCP 3389 from * to * (destinationAddressPrefix='*', sourceAddressPrefix='*', destinationPortRange=3389) with priority 110.
investigation_notes.Description: A contributor-level account (marcus.webb@globalcorp.ee) modified a production NSG (nsg-prod-core) at 11:15 EET and successfully added an Allow rule permitting RDP (TCP/3389) from any source. The activity occurred during local working hours and from an Estonia-based IP, but the account owner’s job is in Legal and not infrastructure, there are no recent correlated deployment events, and the rule creates broad public exposure of a sensitive management port. Because of the unexpected identity-context and the creation of an unrestricted RDP Allow rule to a production NSG, this change is considered High Priority.
